title: localswim service receipt
description: %LOCALAPPDATA%\localswim-v2\service.json, written by the Launch block in docs/windows-operations.md. A reader MUST ignore members it does not use. Patterns end in (?![\s\S]) rather than $, so a trailing line break is refused in every regex dialect.

executable.description: The absolute path of the executable a cold start runs.

data_directory.description: The absolute path of the service's data directory.

base.description: The service's loopback base URL. PORT is the listening port in decimal, 1 to 65535, with no leading zero and no trailing slash.

credential_directory.description: The absolute path of the folder that holds the current cold start's human.json and bot.json.

absolutePath.description: A drive path such as C:\x, or a UNC path such as \\server\share. Only the prefix is checked.
